rows.en: ＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００１Oh, you're here...￥Sorry to bother you while you're￥resting, but got a sec?＝＠０２９＿００２I was shocked when I saw the￥results this time. I wondered￥what kind of magic you used.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００３Never thought I'd get passed by￥YOU. I even started thinking￥maybe I'm all washed up.
Hey, what's that mean?!
Hey, don't feel so down.
Hey, what's that mean?!
Hey, don't feel so down.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００４I meant just what I said.￥I've got my pride too, you know.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００５Losing to someone like you?￥I just can't accept that!
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００６Wow, you can't even tell when￥I'm being sarcastic?
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００７Geez. Losing to someone like￥this makes me feel pathetic.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿００８Anyone can get lucky once.＝＠０２９＿００９I wouldn't get too excited￥if I were you.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１０Well, that's IF these scores￥really reflect your ability.
Of course they are!
What does that mean?
Of course they are!
What does that mean?
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１１Sure, sure. But if people￥doubt you, I think that's your￥own fault.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１２The way you usually act makes￥people want to doubt you.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１３Oh, nothing... But given your￥scores so far, you can't blame￥people for wondering, right?
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１４If this really is what you can￥do, then I guess it deserves￥some respect.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１５Well, congrats on this one!＝＠０２９＿０１６I doubt it'll ever happen￥again, anyway!
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１７All I can say is you got lucky.￥But luck's a kind of skill too.
＊Amane＊＠０２９＿０１８But next time, luck won't be￥enough to beat me! Remember￥that. See ya.
